model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance of several language models across a series of evaluation metrics. The horizontal axis represents the models, displaying the names “mBERT-L2”, “XLM-L2”, “mBERT-R2”, “mBERT-B2”, “XLM-R2”, and “mBERT-B2” in alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents the evaluation metrics and is labeled “Accuracy,” with a linear scale ranging from 0.50 to 0.90. The values are displayed in increments of 0.10, and the tick labels correspond to these increments. The bars are grouped by color, with “mBERT-L2” represented by a dark blue bar, “XLM-L2” by a light blue bar, “mBERT-R2” by a red bar, “mBERT-B2” by a pink bar, “XLM-R2” by a green bar, and “mBERT-B2” by a brown bar. The tallest bar, representing “XLM-L2”, has a value of approximately 0.85, while the shortest bar, representing “mBERT-R2”, has a value of approximately 0.65. Error bars, representing standard deviations, are displayed above each bar, with a maximum value of approximately 0.05 for all bars. No bars are visually emphasized or shaded.
